faqs.question: What is indoor digital billboard advertising?
faqs.answer: It's the placement of your full-motion ads on TV screens inside high-traffic local venues like restaurants, gyms, barbershops, and dessert shops. Your brand is seen where people are already relaxed and engaged, and the ads can't be skipped, paused, or blocked.

faqs.question: Where are your screens located?
faqs.answer: Our screens are in popular businesses across {city} and the surrounding Mid-Cities. See our current host locations.

faqs.question: How do I host a screen in my business?
faqs.answer: Reach out to our team. We'll install an indoor digital screen in your business, create a full-screen ad that plays to your own customers, and run your ads at other nearby non-competing host locations. Learn more about hosting.

faqs.question: Do you offer packages that include screens and online ads?
faqs.answer: Yes! We combine indoor billboards with digital marketing services like social ads, Google Ads, and SEO to maximize your reach both online and offline. Exclusive sponsor opportunities are also available.

faqs.question: Can you help my business rank on Google?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We manage your Google Business Profile, posts, and reviews, and build local search strategies that help your business show up when customers search in {city} and nearby.
